execution_overview.overall_summary: Built and ran the Python analyses in Docker. Task1 and Task2 completed successfully. Results consistently show firms with names starting with 'A' have significantly more complaints (positive and highly significant coefficients across t-test and negative binomial models).

deviations.description: Rewrote margins prediction helper to construct exog and exog_infl with explicit constants and consistent columns for ZeroInflatedPoisson; adjusted ZIP model sections accordingly.
deviations.reason: Initial execution failed with ValueError due to exog/exog_infl shape mismatch during predict for margins.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Followed the planned models (t-test, chi-squared, logistic, Poisson, ZIP, NB). Only implementation fix for ZIP margins; no change to core analysis or dataset.

result_raw.result_text: Negative binomial model shows a positive and highly significant association between having an 'A' name and the number of complaints; A-name firms averaged more complaints.

conclusion.conclusion_text: The result supports the focal claim: firms with names starting with 'A' have more complaints.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Executed the planned two-sample t-test and simple negative binomial regression without controls.

result_raw.result_text: A-name firms have significantly more complaints: t-test difference in means is large and the negative binomial coefficient on first_A is positive and highly significant.

conclusion.conclusion_text: The simple negative binomial model confirms that A-name firms have more complaints.
